reason: Post-relocation workspace setup is the core need. FocusDesk Pro's drawer storage and cable routing directly address ADHD-driven organization requirements, and its scratch-resistant build aligns with durability as my top value. The $429 price is justified by the 4.8 rating versus desk-001's 4.3 at $249 — better quality-per-dollar over the long term. Site experience was functional but the JS-rendered catalog struggled on low bandwidth and there are no individual product detail pages, which made deep research harder than it should be.
